title: No instructions
text:
No instructions. It's a fine piece. Nothing fancy, nothing spectacular. Our problem was that it didn't come with assembly instructions. We looked everywhere and they were nowhere to be found.
My husband still managed to get it put together after much trial and error (and luckily no stripped holes). Annoying to say the least.
